title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, or Python; strong foundation in data structures and algorithms.
description: Work on real-world engineering projects at scale, write clean code, and collaborate with Google software development teams.

title: Chevening Fully Funded Master's Scholarship
eligibility: International applicants with an undergraduate degree and at least 2 years of work experience.
qualification: Undergraduate degree, English proficiency, and demonstrated leadership potential.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master’s degrees at top UK universities.

title: Junior Full Stack Developer
eligibility: Open to early-career developers globally with relevant software development experience.
qualification: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Vue.js, Git, and REST API development.
description: Contribute to the open-source GitLab platform, build modern web features, and work in a fully remote, asynchronous team environment.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or professionals with 0-2 years of experience in product development or tech.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
description: Define product specifications, collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, and deliver features across Microsoft 365 services.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university globally.
qualification: Basic software development skills and a tech startup project built using Azure AI.
description: Global student technology competition encouraging young innovators to solve local and global issues using cutting-edge AI technology.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to all students and self-learners worldwide without prerequisites.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking, problem-solving, and fundamentals of C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
